name: Hasty Pudding
text: Belly 1. Start of Combat: if this has room, swallow the enemy across. It goes back to its own side when this dies, after 3 of your units die, or when its side has nobody else.
golden_text: Belly 2. Start of Combat: if this has room, swallow the enemy across and the enemy nearest it. They go back to their own side when this dies, after 3 of your units die, or when their side has nobody else.
